boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Oberlin spaces with documented roles in studying, meeting, making, and campus cultural life.

cards.title: Academic Commons
cards.subtitle: Seeley G. Mudd Center
cards.notes: Bring a collaborator or laptop: use the workstations, multimedia tools, and research support gathered on Mudd’s main floor.
cards.short_summary: A central Mudd Center work area built for individual and group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin identifies the Academic Commons as a hub for sharing research and information, with 29 workstations for individual or group study plus technology and learning assistance.
cards.source_title: Libraries & Collections | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Located on the main floor of Seeley G. Mudd Center; check library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Perlik Commons
cards.subtitle: Science Center, 119 Woodland St.
cards.notes: Use the two-story commons for a study session or a relaxed meet-up, then continue next door to the Science Library.
cards.short_summary: A sunlit Science Center commons for study and informal connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin describes Perlik Commons as a place where students study, grab a snack, and relax with friends; it is centrally located for students and faculty to meet.
cards.source_title: Facilities: Perlik Commons, Science Center | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Inside the Science Center; access depends on building availability.

cards.title: Bent Corridor
cards.subtitle: Beside Perlik Commons in the Science Center
cards.notes: Walk through on the way to the library and pause to look at the student art and research projects displayed along the corridor.
cards.short_summary: A Science Center passage used to show student work.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin says Bent Corridor, adjacent to Perlik Commons, often displays posters and student art and research projects.
cards.source_title: Facilities: Perlik Commons, Science Center | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Located in the Science Center beside Perlik Commons; access depends on building availability.

cards.title: Science Library
cards.subtitle: Science Center, 119 Woodland St.
cards.notes: Choose a carrel for focused reading or reserve a group room when your work needs conversation and shared materials.
cards.short_summary: A natural-sciences library with group rooms and individual study seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin reports that the Science Library has group study rooms, 31 study carrels, computers, and research support for the natural sciences.
cards.source_title: Libraries & Collections | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: In the Science Center; confirm current library hours and room policies.

cards.title: Clarence Ward Art Library
cards.subtitle: Allen Memorial Art Museum, 83 North Main St.
cards.notes: Pair a gallery visit with focused art research upstairs, using the library’s books, journals, and exhibition catalogs.
cards.short_summary: An art-focused research library atop the Allen Memorial Art Museum.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin states that the Clarence Ward Art Library is on the top floor of the Allen Memorial Art Museum and holds books, exhibition catalogs, periodicals, and journals on art and related fields.
cards.source_title: Libraries & Collections | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Located on the museum’s top floor; check library hours before planning work there.

cards.title: Conservatory Library
cards.subtitle: 77 West College St.
cards.notes: Set up with a score or recording, then use a listening carrel when you need to work through music with headphones.
cards.short_summary: A music research library with dedicated listening carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin says the Conservatory Library supports College and Conservatory students and that students can access recordings in 43 listening carrels.
cards.source_title: Libraries & Collections | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: At 77 West College Street; check library hours and listening-carrel availability.

cards.title: Wilder Hall
cards.subtitle: Student Union, 135 W. Lorain St.
cards.notes: Meet your group in a community room or lounge, and use the building’s student-organization offices as a starting point for campus involvement.
cards.short_summary: Oberlin’s student-union gathering place with rooms, offices, and a lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin identifies Wilder Hall as a gathering place and says it contains community meeting rooms, student-organization offices, and a student lounge.
cards.source_title: Facilities: Wilder Hall | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Building services and rooms may have specific access or reservation requirements.

cards.title: Environmental Studies Information Center
cards.subtitle: Adam Joseph Lewis Center, second floor
cards.notes: Head to the second-floor room for daylight, books, desktop computers, and table space when you want a quieter study setting.
cards.short_summary: A small library and study room in the environmental studies building.
cards.evidence_claim: A 2026 Oberlin student blog describes the ESIC as a single-room library and study spot with natural light, books, desktop computers, tables, and seating.
cards.source_title: Study Spots | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: On the second floor of the Adam Joseph Lewis Center; access depends on building availability.

cards.title: Allen Memorial Art Museum
cards.subtitle: 87 North Main St.
cards.notes: Visit the galleries for a self-directed art break, or connect a class topic to works in the collection with friends.
cards.short_summary: A free campus museum that supports coursework and gallery visits.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin says the Allen Memorial Art Museum’s galleries and programs are free to all and that its artwork connects with students’ coursework.
cards.source_title: Museum and the Arts | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Museum galleries and programs are free; check the museum’s current visitor information before arrival.

cards.title: Wilder Bowl
cards.subtitle: Outside Wilder Hall
cards.notes: Use the lawn-facing side of the student union as an outdoor pause between meetings, classes, or a walk across campus.
cards.short_summary: The green-facing outdoor side of Oberlin’s student union.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin’s Wilder Hall facility page identifies the building’s face overlooking Wilder Bowl and lists Wilder Bowl as a related campus facility.
cards.source_title: Facilities: Wilder Hall | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space beside Wilder Hall; observe posted campus-event and grounds-use guidance.
